nominal_probability_interpretation.qualification: Analytical intended hash-modulo probabilities, not measured assignment frequencies.

bounded_experiment.intervention: For four consecutive 3-assignment batches, permit one <=20-minute evidence-gap follow-up. Require exact source binding, retained Racket labels for four distinct queries when supported, demonstration-only competitor checks, and visible-payload deduplication.
metrics: accepted source-bound episodes per reviewer+Racket minute
unresolved lesson competitors after the follow-up
duplicate visible payloads rejected before export
bounded_experiment.population: 12 future assignments produced by the unchanged current draw policy
bounded_experiment.stop_rule: Stop after four interventions, or earlier if the first two both exceed 20 minutes, cannot obtain an independent authority label, or leave a query-changing competitor unresolved.
bounded_experiment.success_rule: Adopt the follow-up queue only if at least 2 of 4 interventions produce a source-bound, competitor-checked receipt with four distinct Racket-labelled queries (or a documented hard support limit), zero silent duplicates, and median measured follow-up time <=20 minutes.

comparison.alternative: Preserve every draw probability, approval, and training boundary, but add a bounded post-draw follow-up queue: among each three already-drawn records, spend at most one extra slot on the highest source-bound value class—unresolved lesson defect first, then independently reviewed family lacking four-query Racket receipts, then receipt-continuity repair, then new volume.
comparison.baseline: Keep the current 10% evaluation focus and hash-uniform normal target selection; treat a selected generator as one authoring unit without an evidence-gap triage stage.

estimated_quality_per_cost.alternative_estimate: In this sample, all 3/3 records expose a concrete value target and 1/3 has a reproduced lesson defect. A <=20-minute follow-up on the best candidate is estimated to yield more usable supervision per review/Racket minute than adding another untriaged same-rule record.
estimated_quality_per_cost.baseline_estimate: One new or edited record per authoring slot, with unknown admission yield when source-bound lesson ambiguity and receipt gaps are not triaged.
estimated_quality_per_cost.estimate_limit: Three records are not representative; no measured reviewer-time, rejection-rate, Racket-time, deduplication-yield, or model-utility telemetry is present.

coverage_limits: The sample is three uniform manifest records, not a stratified estimate of the 162-target normal pool or approved dataset mixture.
No sampled record is labelled ARC-GEN or RE-ARC; no source-family quality or volume claim about either corpus follows.
The dynamic check used Python generation/self_check only; it did not create fresh Racket labels or prove lesson identifiability.
Four distinct generated inputs are not equivalent to four distinct Racket-labelled, demonstration-identifiable queries.
Catalog primitive lists are metadata, not measured executed grammar coverage.
Catalog mix_weight 1.0 does not imply authoring priority, approval, safety, or training admission.
Existing reviewer-reported findings remain source-bound and were not re-executed by this allocation probe.

dataset_catalog.distinction: Catalog mix_weight affects dataset sampling after filters; it is not used by the authoring draw, which selects from manifest priority pools and reserves 10% for evaluation focus.

outcome.summary: Deterministic three-record audit found heterogeneous evidence quality despite identical sample mix_weight 1.0: one reproduced unresolved lesson shortcut, one independently checked repair, and one reviewed-safe record with receipt-continuity gaps. Proposed a four-intervention post-draw triage test while preserving the 10% focus and all current draw/approval/training boundaries.
